questions.stem: What does the blob Private Endpoint place inside CLZ-350's data subnet?

options.C: A Terraform state server
options.D: A private network interface and address for the service connection

optionExplanations.A: Storage remains a managed service, not a subnet VM.
optionExplanations.B: This path is private.
optionExplanations.C: The endpoint is not a Terraform backend server.
optionExplanations.D: The endpoint provides a private service access point.

questions.stem: Which Private Endpoint target subresource does this lesson configure?

options.C: queue
options.D: sqlServer

optionExplanations.A: Files need their own service connection.
optionExplanations.B: The connection explicitly selects blob.
optionExplanations.C: Queues are a different Storage subresource.
optionExplanations.D: sqlServer is for Azure SQL.

questions.stem: A private endpoint is added to a Storage account. What separate setting enforces this lesson's private-only intent?

options.C: Public network access disabled
options.D: A tag named private

optionExplanations.A: Uniqueness does not restrict networking.
optionExplanations.B: TTL controls caching, not admission.
optionExplanations.C: Private Endpoint creation alone does not disable public access.
optionExplanations.D: Tags do not enforce access.

questions.stem: Which zone does CLZ-350 link for Blob Storage private resolution?

options.C: trafficmanager.net
options.D: core.windows.net

optionExplanations.A: This is the configured Blob Private Link zone.
optionExplanations.B: That zone serves Azure SQL.
optionExplanations.C: Traffic Manager is unrelated.
optionExplanations.D: The broad public domain is not this private overlay.

questions.stem: A private client wants to access the account's blob service. Which hostname should its application normally use?

options.B: A hard-coded private IP in the TLS URL
options.C: The resource-group name
options.D: The Terraform resource address

optionExplanations.A: DNS maps the regular service hostname to the private path.
optionExplanations.B: An IP can break hostname-based TLS validation.
optionExplanations.C: A resource-group name is not a service URL.
optionExplanations.D: Terraform addresses are not application endpoints.

questions.stem: Azure shows Succeeded and Approved for the endpoint. Which claim is still unproven?

options.C: A real client's DNS and blob access work
options.D: Its provisioning completed

optionExplanations.A: The returned resource proves existence.
optionExplanations.B: The status directly records approval.
optionExplanations.C: Resource state does not prove the client's complete data path.
optionExplanations.D: Succeeded is the provisioning result.

questions.stem: Which environment can perform the documented private DNS and TCP checks?

options.A: Any Internet laptop with no private connection
options.B: A client in the linked VNet or correctly connected network
options.C: The MkDocs hosting server by default
options.D: Any browser after changing its theme

optionExplanations.A: Public access is disabled.
optionExplanations.B: Routing and DNS must reach the private endpoint.
optionExplanations.C: Documentation hosting does not imply VNet access.
optionExplanations.D: Theme choice does not create network connectivity.

questions.stem: A normal Internet laptop cannot reach the blob service after apply. What is the appropriate interpretation?

options.B: Proof the account needs anonymous containers
options.C: Proof TLS must be disabled
options.D: Expected isolation unless it has the private network and DNS path

optionExplanations.A: Internet failure alone does not establish endpoint failure.
optionExplanations.B: Anonymous access does not fix private routing.
optionExplanations.C: TLS is still required.
optionExplanations.D: Private-only networking intentionally excludes that path.

questions.stem: A client inside the intended VNet gets a public address for the blob host. What should be investigated first?

options.C: Zone group, VNet link, and its DNS resolver path
options.D: Only the Markdown architecture image

optionExplanations.A: Suffix length does not make a DNS link.
optionExplanations.B: Replication does not select the client's resolver.
optionExplanations.C: Those components determine private name resolution.
optionExplanations.D: An image cannot configure DNS.

questions.stem: Why create a Private DNS virtual-network link?

options.A: Make the zone's records resolvable through that VNet's supported DNS path
options.B: Grant every user Blob Data Owner
options.C: Open public network access
options.D: Copy the Storage account into the VNet

optionExplanations.A: The link scopes zone resolution to the network.
optionExplanations.B: DNS links do not grant identity roles.
optionExplanations.C: Public access is independently disabled.
optionExplanations.D: Managed Storage is not copied into a subnet.

questions.stem: What does the endpoint's private_dns_zone_group associate?

options.A: The VMSS with a load balancer
options.B: The public registrar with Azure DNS
options.C: All tenant users with blob permissions
options.D: The endpoint with the appropriate private DNS zone

optionExplanations.A: No VMSS is created here.
optionExplanations.B: Private zones do not require registrar delegation.
optionExplanations.C: DNS association is not identity authorization.
optionExplanations.D: It integrates the connection with the selected zone.

questions.stem: TCP 443 to the private blob host succeeds but a blob read is denied. What still requires verification?

options.C: Only whether DNS returned a private IP
options.D: Only the SVG caption

optionExplanations.A: The successful TCP test already confirms that port path.
optionExplanations.B: Connectivity does not grant blob data permissions.
optionExplanations.C: Private resolution is not permission.
optionExplanations.D: Documentation cannot grant access.

questions.stem: Which DNS result matches the lesson's expected private endpoint placement?

options.C: A Traffic Manager profile name without an address
options.D: The resource group's subscription GUID

optionExplanations.A: The client's egress IP is not the service NIC.
optionExplanations.B: The endpoint receives a private address from the data subnet.
optionExplanations.C: This lesson does not create a Traffic Manager target.
optionExplanations.D: A GUID is not an IP address.

questions.stem: An endpoint connection is Pending. What should be examined?

options.C: The Traffic Manager priority
options.D: Connection approval and blob subresource selection

optionExplanations.A: Book metadata is unrelated.
optionExplanations.B: No VM is created by this lesson.
optionExplanations.C: No Traffic Manager profile is created here.
optionExplanations.D: Approval and the chosen service affect connection establishment.

questions.stem: A blob Private Endpoint is healthy. Does that prove a private file-share connection is configured?

options.A: No; file is a distinct target subresource
options.B: Yes; blob includes every Storage protocol
options.C: Yes; all storage DNS zones are identical
options.D: Only if the account name starts with st

optionExplanations.A: Private endpoints are service-specific.
optionExplanations.B: A blob connection does not automatically cover file.
optionExplanations.C: Service DNS overlays differ.
optionExplanations.D: Naming does not change endpoint coverage.

questions.stem: Why test the normal blob FQDN rather than disable certificate checks against a private IP?

options.A: It removes the need for authorization
options.C: It validates the intended hostname and private path together
options.D: It makes transactions free

optionExplanations.A: Authorization remains required.
optionExplanations.B: Connectivity testing does not establish disaster recovery.
optionExplanations.C: Hostname-based tests preserve meaningful TLS evidence.
optionExplanations.D: Tests may still incur service transactions.

questions.stem: Which resource is required for validation but intentionally not deployed by CLZ-350?

options.C: A Storage account
options.D: An in-VNet test client

optionExplanations.A: The endpoint is in the Terraform configuration.
optionExplanations.B: The zone is explicitly created.
optionExplanations.C: The account is explicitly created.
optionExplanations.D: The prerequisites ask for an existing private client.

questions.stem: The VNet uses a custom resolver that ignores its Azure Private DNS link. What design work may be needed?

options.C: Correct forwarding or private resolution integration
options.D: Publishing the private IP as a credential

optionExplanations.A: Tags do not configure resolvers.
optionExplanations.B: Removing the endpoint defeats the private path.
optionExplanations.C: A custom DNS path must reach the private zone appropriately.
optionExplanations.D: An IP is neither a DNS integration nor a credential.

questions.stem: Which billable component remains relevant even with little blob capacity?

options.B: Private Endpoint hours and data processing
options.C: Every Markdown page
options.D: Terraform variable names

optionExplanations.A: Bastion is not deployed in this lesson.
optionExplanations.B: The private connectivity service has its own charges.
optionExplanations.C: Documentation pages do not incur Azure service charges.
optionExplanations.D: Variable names are not usage meters.

questions.stem: Standard LRS is used here. What should precede choosing geo-redundancy for production?

options.A: Match durability and recovery requirements with costs
options.B: Assume Private Endpoint makes all storage geo-redundant
options.C: Change only the DNS caption
options.D: Delete all backup plans

optionExplanations.A: Replication choice is a separate production design decision.
optionExplanations.B: Private connectivity is not a replication mode.
optionExplanations.C: A caption cannot change durability.
optionExplanations.D: Backup and recovery requirements still matter.

questions.stem: allow_nested_items_to_be_public=false contributes to which restriction?

options.A: Granting every VNet user write access
options.C: Preventing public container-level access configuration
options.D: Disabling TLS

optionExplanations.A: Private connectivity does not grant all users permissions.
optionExplanations.B: Identity authorization remains separate.
optionExplanations.C: It restricts anonymous/public data exposure.
optionExplanations.D: TLS settings are separately configured.

questions.stem: A reviewed plan unexpectedly enables Storage public networking. What should the learner do?

options.A: Apply because the endpoint hides the public path
options.B: Stop and correct the configuration before a new plan
options.C: Ignore the change if tags say private
options.D: Run the Internet test and accept any success

optionExplanations.A: An endpoint does not hide an enabled public access path.
optionExplanations.B: It conflicts with the lesson's explicit private-only setting.
optionExplanations.C: Tags are not security enforcement.
optionExplanations.D: Successful public access contradicts the stated intent.

questions.stem: Which pair separates resource provisioning evidence from a representative data path?

options.A: Inspect endpoint state, then test DNS and TCP from the private client
options.B: Inspect tags, then count Terraform files
options.C: Read README, then assume Approved means all clients work
options.D: Run fmt twice and skip network tests

optionExplanations.A: The pair covers control-plane state and client connectivity.
optionExplanations.B: Those checks do not test the private path.
optionExplanations.C: Approval does not test every resolver and route.
optionExplanations.D: Formatting is a source check.

questions.stem: Which exercise records how the service hostname maps to a private address?

options.C: Resolve the unrelated GitHub Pages host
options.D: Trace the blob hostname's CNAME and A records from an in-VNet client

optionExplanations.A: Keys are unnecessary sensitive evidence.
optionExplanations.B: Tags do not show DNS resolution.
optionExplanations.C: The site hostname is not the blob data path.
optionExplanations.D: The exercise inspects the actual private DNS chain.

questions.stem: What should this lesson's successful destroy remove?

options.A: Its account, endpoint, private zone/link, and network resources
options.B: Every Storage account in the tenant
options.C: An unrelated DNS resolver in another group
options.D: The external validation client by assumption

optionExplanations.A: Destroy follows this configuration's managed resource ownership.
optionExplanations.B: Tenant-wide deletion is outside scope.
optionExplanations.C: An unrelated resolver is not managed here.
optionExplanations.D: The client is a prerequisite, not a deployed resource.

questions.stem: Which check verifies active resource-group removal after destroy?

options.A: A valid public DNS answer for GitHub
options.C: A new screenshot of the diagram
options.D: az group exists for the captured lesson group returns false

optionExplanations.A: GitHub DNS is unrelated.
optionExplanations.B: Assessments do not inspect Azure.
optionExplanations.C: Diagrams are explanatory, not live evidence.
optionExplanations.D: The Azure query checks the actual lesson lifecycle boundary.

questions.stem: A public resolver can still resolve the account hostname while public network access is disabled. What does that mean?

options.A: The private access setting must have reverted
options.C: DNS visibility alone does not grant blob access
options.D: The private IP must be exposed to every resolver

optionExplanations.A: Resolution alone does not prove a setting change.
optionExplanations.B: Authorization and network admission still apply.
optionExplanations.C: Name existence and service access are independent.
optionExplanations.D: Public resolution need not disclose the private endpoint IP.

questions.stem: Why arrange a private client before testing a public-disabled deployment?

options.A: Terraform requires a client VM resource in every plan
options.B: Otherwise the learner lacks a representative data-plane test path
options.C: The endpoint must copy data from the client
options.D: The private client replaces all access roles

optionExplanations.A: The lesson deliberately creates no client.
optionExplanations.B: The control plane can succeed while the learner cannot reach the data path.
optionExplanations.C: No client-to-service migration is configured.
optionExplanations.D: Client location does not replace identity permissions.

questions.stem: Which statement distinguishes a service endpoint from this Private Endpoint pattern?

options.A: Both patterns always deploy a private service VM
options.C: This pattern exposes a private service NIC/IP in the subnet
options.D: Both patterns automatically grant data roles

optionExplanations.A: Managed services are not deployed as subnet VMs.
optionExplanations.B: Private DNS links are not public delegation.
optionExplanations.C: The endpoint is a private network interface for the service.
optionExplanations.D: Network paths do not assign data roles automatically.

questions.stem: What production check goes beyond merely recording Approved once?

options.B: Disable public access checks after the first plan
options.C: Treat every 403 as successful availability
options.D: Continuously test private DNS and TLS from representative clients

optionExplanations.A: Name churn is not monitoring.
optionExplanations.B: Settings and data paths can drift.
optionExplanations.C: A 403 may indicate authorization or network issues.
optionExplanations.D: Availability depends on the ongoing real client path.
